beliefs_note: Priors are the author's, written before any check ran, and are Zach's to overwrite. Verdicts follow the RET ledger: CONFIRMED, FALSIFIED, REVISED, OPEN. `scope` and `frame` come from the lists `scopes` and `frames`, fixed before any belief resolves. A resolved belief needs `resolved_on`, and `reason_logged_at` must not be later than it. `pr` (optional) is the probability of REVISED, which turns the score into a three-outcome score.

lessons.rule: A date or figure from memory is not an input. Every anchor carries status and source; the plan date may not rest on an UNVERIFIED anchor without saying so

lessons.from: RET K7, K16, K48, B47 (tests that cannot fail; 2,048 vacuous passes)
lessons.rule: Every gate must be shown to fail on a planted fault before it is trusted

lessons.from: RET K12 (log time is not event time)

lessons.from: RET B65 (a printed hit is not a gate)

lessons.from: RET K13, B40 (a labelled guess still reads as a finding)

Comfortable slack everywhere is a warning sign, not a result; check what was left out
lessons.gate: inlier (--strict fails when min slack is over half the window)

base_case.rule: Pinned. It equals the earliest anchor on file (2026-05-04) + 12 months - 30 day buffer. Other anchors are scenarios. If any anchor would put the date earlier than this, the base_case gate fails and the plan must be re-based on purpose.
